top_categories.workout_context: 1118 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
88,583ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Race Through Poland's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At Race Through Poland, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 1118 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88,583ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
79ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at Race Through Poland. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 1118 miles.
1118 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 88,583ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Race Through Poland. Train it until it feels boring.
Low-cadence force work supports 88,583ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 1118-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.altitude: Race Through Poland includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Race Through Poland rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, VO2max, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 1118 miles of mixed terrain in Nowy Targ, Poland.
